# Venkata Lakshmi Parimala Pasupuleti

### Software Engineer & AI Builder

I'm a software engineer with 8+ years of industry experience, currently focused on building AI systems. I recently completed my **MS in Data Analytics Engineering at George Mason University** (GPA 3.87) and built **AgentProbe** — an open-source agentic AI testing toolkit for LLM, RAG, and multi-agent systems using LangChain, LangGraph, ChromaDB, and FastAPI.

Most of my career was spent at **Entrata India**, one of the largest property management platforms in the US, where I worked on systems handling over 1 million property records and 100K+ monthly active users. I worked across database architecture, microservices, cloud migration to AWS, encryption, and performance optimization — learning what it means to build software that actually holds up at scale.

I care about building things that work, not just demos. Whether it's a RAG pipeline that needs debugging, an agentic workflow that needs to adapt, or a SQL query that needs tuning, I approach every problem by understanding it deeply before writing a single line of code.

## Projects

### AgentProbe — Agentic AI Testing Toolkit 🔍
**Python · LangChain · LangGraph · FastAPI · ChromaDB · Ollama · React** · [GitHub ↗](https://github.com/venkatalakshmiparimala/AgentProbe)

Pre-deployment testing, benchmarking, and debugging toolkit for LLM, RAG, and multi-agent systems. Built three LangGraph agents that think and adapt: an **Orchestrator Agent** that runs adaptive 3-phase stress tests (explore → target weak spots → verify failures), a **RAG Tracer Agent** that diagnoses 7 pipeline steps to find exactly where it broke, and an **Auto Fix Agent** that generates ready-to-use fixes — rewritten prompts, chunk configs, and query rewrites. A smart **LLM Router** auto-selects the optimal model per task. Runs 100% locally at zero cost.
